preserveReasons.set-up_y2: Structural second-year festival map, actor, animation and control command script; preserved byte-for-byte.

corrections: Translated and reread all nineteen player-facing spring24 records from source ordinals 24 through 43 directly from English and preserved the second-year set-up script byte-for-byte.
Preserved every player, dialogue, emotion and asterisk marker, reused the reviewed Dwarf and Sandy wording, and avoided assumptions about the player’s gender in spouse dialogue.
Kept all character voices and refined the frog-season, shared-effort and forest-hike phrasing for natural Bulgarian.
